description: Implement chart and data visualization accessibility with alternative text representations, keyboard navigation, and accessible data alternatives for screen readers
steps: Update ChartWrapper.tsx to include descriptive alt text summarizing chart data and trends for screen readers
Add accessible data table alternatives for each chart component (ExamLineChart, RoomUtilizationChart, ExamDistributionPieChart, etc.)
Implement keyboard navigation for interactive chart elements using arrow keys and Enter
Add aria-label attributes to chart containers describing chart type and data range
Create chart description components that provide text summaries of key insights for non-visual users
Ensure color is not the only means of conveying information in charts (use patterns, labels, etc.)
Add chart data export functionality accessible via keyboard for users who need raw data access
acceptance_criteria: All charts have descriptive aria-label attributes explaining the chart purpose and data
Data table alternatives are available for each chart, accessible via keyboard
Interactive chart elements support keyboard navigation
Charts do not rely solely on color to convey information
Chart descriptions provide meaningful insights for screen reader users
Chart data can be accessed in alternative formats (table, export) via keyboard
verification: npm run type-check passes without errors
Manual test: Navigate charts with keyboard and verify alternative access methods
Screen reader test: Verify chart descriptions and data table alternatives are announced
Visual test: Ensure charts remain readable without color (simulate color blindness)
